## How it was checked

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Client changes: `make build-client` starts; `make check-anticheat-imports` passes on Windows
- [ ] Voice, streams or input changes: live test described below
- [ ] Protocol changes: `make gen` run, server, core and UI updated together
- [ ] Departure from the design: ADR added in `docs/adr/`
